summary.en: Arm64 runtime libraries that native Arm64 apps built with Visual C++ depend on. The installer is VC_redist.arm64.exe.
summary.zh-TW: 原生 Arm64 應用程式（以 Visual C++ 建置）所需的執行階段函式庫，安裝程式為 VC_redist.arm64.exe。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
